integrity: The analytic proof gives the universal statement; finite exact and numerical checks are supplementary. The prior equilateral benchmark and universal convex bound are credited.
scientific_limitations: The triangle inequality is established for nondegenerate Euclidean triangles, not all convex cycles. Earlier equilateral ratio and weaker convex-cycle bound are known. Full text of Grüne dissertation remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp triangle area bound and complete classification of shortest perimeter-halving chords
